p: Merodachbaladan: This was the first king of Babylon, who overcame the Assyrians in the tenth year of his reign.
they seen in thy house: He asks him of the particulars, to make him understand the craft of the wicked, which he before being overcome with their flattery and blinded with ambition, could not see.
carried to Babylon: By the grievousness of the punishment is declared how greatly God detested ambition and vain glory.
eunuchs in the palace of the: That is, officers and servants.
Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah: Read 2Ki 20:19.
